scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @forgefastlabs/beacon-engine && npm run build -w @forgefastlabs/beacon-mcp && npm run build -w @forgefastlabs/beacon-cli && npm run build -w beacon-security
scripts.publish:packages: npm run build:packages && npm publish -w @forgefastlabs/beacon-engine --access public && npm publish -w @forgefastlabs/beacon-mcp --access public && npm publish -w @forgefastlabs/beacon-cli --access public
scripts.publish:packages:dry: npm run build:packages && npm publish -w @forgefastlabs/beacon-engine --access public --dry-run && npm publish -w @forgefastlabs/beacon-mcp --access public --dry-run && npm publish -w @forgefastlabs/beacon-cli --access public --dry-run
